The '''JL7 Elixir''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|hoverscooter]] manufactured by [[GoCorp/Legends|GoCorp]]. [[Abbot]] [[Drayk]] of the [[Dim-U monastery/Legends|Dim-U monastery]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] used a JL7 to move around after being paralyzed.<ref name="GG7" />
